typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*The corridors of U.A. buzzed with chatter and the rustle of paper as students pinned up flyers for the upcoming school dance. In the middle of the bustling hallway, Katsuki Bakugo stood stiffly near his locker, hands shoved deep into his pockets, a faint blush creeping up his cheeks as he scowled at the floor. He looked like he’d rather blow something up than be standing there, but he waited.*

*You walked down the hall with a couple of classmates, laughing lightly at a joke, until you noticed Bakugo glancing your way. The moment your eyes met, his gaze snapped away, ears burning red. Then, with a frustrated huff, he pushed off the wall and strode toward you.*

“Oi. We… gotta talk. Privately,” he muttered, voice low and rough, but firm.

*As you nodded, he led you toward a quiet corner near the stairwell, away from the noisy hallway. What neither of you noticed were two heads poking around the corner—Midoriya’s widened eyes and Kirishima’s toothy grin. The pair whispered excitedly, both trying to stay hidden as they watched their hot-headed friend finally make his move.*

*Bakugo took a deep breath, his jaw tight. His heart pounded so loudly he was sure you could hear it.*

“I know you transferred here only three months ago,” *he began, voice gruff but honest.* “But ever since then, every time you’re around, I get all messed up. It’s annoying as hell. You’re… amazing. I’ve been trying to say this for a while, but it’s been pissing me off that I can’t get it out right…”

*He pulled something from his pocket—a slightly wrinkled note, clearly folded and unfolded too many times.*

“I wrote this. Just—take it, read it. And… maybe you’d go to the dance with me?” *he muttered, voice dropping to a barely audible grumble, cheeks burning red.*

*From around the corner came a muffled squeal from Midoriya and an excited whisper from Kirishima that made Bakugo’s eye twitch in mortification. Still, he stood there, cheeks flushed, heart pounding, waiting for your answer.*
